name: leanrea Reverse Engineer

meta.description: Reverse Engineer Anything. Routes a target by magic bytes, runs the real RE CLIs (rabin2, objdump, readelf, r2, tshark, wabt, unblob, jadx, apktool, Ghidra headless, pwn checksec), and keeps durable per-project state: a step log, a findings ledger with seen/inferred/unknown discipline, and context-budget accounting. resume() and handoff() rebuild working context from disk after a crash or context loss.

manifest.title: leanrea Reverse Engineer
manifest.author: alex
manifest.description: Per-project reverse engineering with durable step logs, a findings ledger, and context-budget accounting.

specs.name: toolchain
specs.description: Report which RE tools resolve, which are missing, and what the fallback is.

specs.name: install
specs.description:
Install RE tools. Pass a space or comma separated list. With no list, install what
the detected router row for the target needs. Reports the command when ALLOW_INSTALL is
off rather than running it.

specs.name: ensure
specs.description:
Check the detected row's tools. Install what is missing if allowed, otherwise give
the fallback in the same row. A missing tool is never treated as a blocker.

specs.name: rules
specs.description: Reload leanrea's operating rules. Cheap way to restore discipline in a fresh context.

specs.name: plan
specs.description: Open or update a project: goal, target, authorization basis, open questions, next actions.

specs.name: route
specs.description: Detect by magic bytes first, then the fastest path, the traps, and the first move.

specs.name: copy
specs.description: Copy the target into the project work dir so the original is never touched.

specs.name: recon
specs.description: Run the single batched inventory call for the detected row, in one shell call.

specs.name: run
specs.description: Run one batched probe inside the project dir. Full output is saved; only the head returns.

specs.name: search
specs.description: Search an extracted tree with rg -uu so hidden and ignored files are included.

specs.name: slice
specs.description: Slice around a needle instead of reading a whole minified file.

specs.name: outgrep
specs.description: Search output already saved by earlier calls instead of re-running an expensive probe.

specs.name: extract
specs.description: Extract a container into its own dir: asar, apktool, jadx, unblob, zip, ar.

specs.name: decompile
specs.description: Pseudocode for one function via r2, or a full Ghidra headless decompile to disk.

specs.name: parse
specs.description: Run a stdlib parser for formats with no CLI: scan, dex, axml, apksig, asar, hermes, pe, macho, wasm.

specs.name: find
specs.description: Record a finding. status is seen, inferred, or unknown. Cite file:offset or a symbol.

specs.name: answer
specs.description: Build the answer from the ledger only: seen claims cited, inferred marked, unknown listed.

specs.name: log
specs.description: Read the per-project log: every step in order with action, status and detail.

specs.name: resume
specs.description: Rebuild working context after a crash or context loss, from the log and ledger on disk.

specs.name: handoff
specs.description: Compact handoff for a fresh context window: established facts, open questions, next actions.

specs.name: stop
specs.description: Close a project with a stated reason so a later context knows where it ended and why.
